text: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. publicly filed its initial Form S-1 on May 20, 2026.
textZh: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. 于 2026 年 5 月 20 日公开提交初始 S-1 注册声明。

text: The SEC notice records the registration statement as effective at 10:00 a.m. America/New_York on June 11, 2026.
textZh: SEC 通知记录该注册声明于 2026 年 6 月 11 日美国东部时间上午 10:00 生效。

text: The IPO was priced at $135 per Class A share for a base offering of 555,555,555 shares, with an 83,333,333-share underwriter option.
textZh: IPO 的 A 类股发行价为每股 135 美元，基础发行 555,555,555 股，并授予承销商 83,333,333 股选择权。

parameterMapping.mappingLimit: Reference price only; the share count is not mapped to free float or immediate tradable supply.

text: SpaceX Class A shares began trading on Nasdaq under the symbol SPCX on June 12, 2026; Nasdaq reported a $150 opening cross.
textZh: SpaceX A 类股于 2026 年 6 月 12 日开始在 Nasdaq 以 SPCX 代码交易；Nasdaq 报告的开盘交叉价为 150 美元。
limitations: The exact opening-cross timestamp is not stored without a licensed market-data record.

text: The IPO closed after the sale of 638,888,888 shares at $135 per share, including the underwriters' full option, for approximately $85.7 billion in gross proceeds.
textZh: IPO 以每股 135 美元完成交割，含承销商全部选择权共售出 638,888,888 股，总募资额约 857 亿美元。
limitations: Shares sold are not equivalent to observed free float or immediately tradable supply.

text: The Nasdaq-100 methodology permits Fast Entry for a newly listed company that satisfies the stated market-capitalization, liquidity, and eligibility tests, with evaluation and announcement timing defined by the methodology.
textZh: Nasdaq-100 方法论允许满足市值、流动性和资格测试的新上市公司快速纳入，并规定了评估与公告时序。

text: Nasdaq publicly announced that SpaceX would join the Nasdaq-100 at 20:00 America/New_York on June 26, 2026, which is 2026-06-27T00:00:00Z.
textZh: Nasdaq 于 2026 年 6 月 26 日美国东部时间 20:00 公开宣布 SpaceX 将加入 Nasdaq-100，对应 UTC 时间 2026-06-27T00:00:00Z。
pointInTimeRule: Must not be exposed to any agent or scenario state before 2026-06-27T00:00:00Z.

text: Nasdaq stated that SpaceX would become a Nasdaq-100 component before the market opened on July 7, 2026.
textZh: Nasdaq 表示 SpaceX 将于 2026 年 7 月 7 日开盘前成为 Nasdaq-100 成分股。
limitations: The 13:30Z value is a normal market-open boundary, not an exchange-published exact effective timestamp.

text: Nasdaq said that more than 200 exchange-traded products in 17 countries tracked the Nasdaq-100, representing more than $800 billion in assets under management.
textZh: Nasdaq 表示，17 个国家有超过 200 个交易所交易产品跟踪 Nasdaq-100，相关管理资产超过 8000 亿美元。
limitations: Tracking assets are not equivalent to SpaceX purchase demand or realized passive inflows.

text: FTSE Russell announced a separate global-equity fast entry for SpaceX effective from the June 22, 2026 open.
textZh: FTSE Russell 另行宣布 SpaceX 快速纳入全球股票指数，并自 2026 年 6 月 22 日开盘起生效。

text: FTSE Russell announced SpaceX additions to the Russell 1000 and related U.S. indexes after the June 26, 2026 close.
textZh: FTSE Russell 宣布 SpaceX 将在 2026 年 6 月 26 日收盘后加入 Russell 1000 等美国指数。

text: SpaceX disclosed the pricing and subsequent closing of senior notes with an aggregate principal amount of $25 billion during the index-event window.
textZh: SpaceX 在指数事件窗口内披露了本金总额 250 亿美元的高级票据定价及后续交割。

text: The FCC authorized a second tranche of 7,500 Gen2 Starlink satellites, bringing the authorized Gen2 total to 15,000 subject to stated conditions, while deferring action on the remainder.
textZh: FCC 批准第二批 7,500 颗第二代 Starlink 卫星，使附条件授权总数达到 15,000 颗，并继续延后处理其余申请。

text: NASA's Inspector General reported material Human Landing System schedule and technical-integration challenges and said the SpaceX lander would not be ready for a June 2027 lunar landing.
textZh: NASA 监察长报告指出载人登月系统存在显著进度与技术集成挑战，并表示 SpaceX 登月器无法在 2027 年 6 月前准备就绪。

text: For this simulation only, displayed order-book depth is assumed to be limited relative to concentrated event-driven order flow.
textZh: 仅在本次仿真中，假设可见订单簿深度相对于集中的事件驱动订单流较为有限。

parameterMapping.mappingLimit: Dimensionless synthetic proxy; not calibrated from observed SPCX depth.

text: For this simulation only, index-related demand is represented by a bounded synthetic execution schedule rather than an observed or inferred historical order stream.
textZh: 仅在本次仿真中，指数相关需求由有界的合成执行时间表表示，而不是已观测或推断的历史订单流。
limitations: The Nasdaq tracking-assets statement is not converted into a purchase amount.
The post-event JPMorgan estimate is excluded from simulation inputs.

text: A concurrent broad-market risk-off sell flow is injected as a synthetic stress condition at the simulation event step.
textZh: 仿真在事件步骤注入一股同步的广泛市场风险规避卖出流，作为合成压力条件。

text: A later clarification is scheduled as a synthetic information event that reduces narrative uncertainty without directly setting a price.
textZh: 随后安排一条合成澄清信息，用于降低叙事不确定性，但不会直接设定价格。
pointInTimeRule: The cognition layer must not expose this scheduled synthetic event to an agent before its simulation-clock arrival.
